lifecycle.cleanup: At most one full row per invocation: before new preparation or owner-only empty POST application/data-channels/cleanup. Server clock only; lazy, not scheduled erasure for idle projects. Up to4 CAS attempts.
lifecycle.newIdPolicy: Trusted UUIDv7; original deadline<=ID timestamp+TTL and parent expiry. Unknown future ID denied. Unknown retired/old ID cannot gain a refreshed deadline. Existing retained immutable row replay unchanged.
lifecycle.replayBarrier: Full row delete, slot removal and monotonic retiredThroughMs in one CAS transaction. Conservatively rejects any unknown UUIDv7 at or below floor, including after clock rollback.
lifecycle.compatibility: Existing UUIDv4/ids-only ledgers indexed lazily. At most16 legacy tombstones retained; new unknown UUIDv4 refused. Canonical binding schema1 unchanged.
lifecycle.concurrency: Competing collectors validated on real KV; CAS retries re-read current ledger/row. Runtime yields before full-context digest to bound turn budget.

asyncBoundary.read: PrivateDataPort.read returns Promise; initial primitive snapshot after lookup; immutable delegated mode independent of nullable live context.
asyncBoundary.write: ResourceAccessFence.assertCurrent returns Promise and is awaited before write work and immediately before commit. Binding/application/release checks remain in the same record/resource CAS.
asyncBoundary.tested: Async synthetic lookup loses context after authorization while pending write awaits; denied401 and record absent. Existing SDK-await mutation/loss and valid bearer no-downgrade project/binary probes still pass.
asyncBoundary.nativeProof: No production native adapter or guessed URI/header/env/API added. Synthetic port is not transport provenance.

verification.httpScopeNote: Closed verify repeats owner-data reopen checks; HTTP pass groups not counted as additional unique offline coverage.
